clock.assumption: Assumes the trend continues at the current Theil-Sen rate, and that the noise around it stays like the record's: AR(1), with the lag-1 autocorrelation and the standard deviation of the anomalies after removing the Theil-Sen line. Each simulation adds future years to the observed record and reruns the same Hamed-Rao test. The years are counted from the end of the record.

provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly precipitation (Precipitation Corrected, mm/day) for Madrid, Spain (Iberia), 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.

verdict.label: inconclusive
verdict.reason: The test cannot tell this trend from noise (p = 0.178), and the slope's interval, widened for autocorrelation, reaches past ±0.0357 per decade, so a trend that size is not ruled out.
